name: turn-timing
description: Append configurable turn timing to Claude Desktop's collapsed activity summary

language.title: Language
language.description: Auto / 自动, 中文, English, 日本語, Custom / 自定义. Auto follows explicit LANG/LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Text before the timing line. Leave empty for none. Example: ⏱

totalLabel.title: Total label
totalLabel.description: Custom label for total wall-clock time. Used when Language is custom.

thinkingLabel.title: Thinking label
thinkingLabel.description: Custom label for streamed thinking time. Used when Language is custom.

respondingLabel.title: Responding label
respondingLabel.description: Custom label for generated response time. Used when Language is custom.

toolsLabel.title: Tools label
toolsLabel.description: Custom label for tool-call time. Used when Language is custom.
